ward.summary: Andheri West, Juhu and Vile Parle West (ward K/W) spent ₹78.5 lakh of its ₹89.0 lakh budget, 88%, so it stayed within budget across 143 jobs. Some 26% of repairs were redone within 30 days, matching the expected 26%, though repairs that failed account for ₹18.7 lakh; the ward is flood-prone (flood index 0.70), which makes repairs harder to keep in place. On-time completion was 56% against an expected 48%. Thirteen jobs are listed for review, and 29 jobs, ₹17.1 lakh, were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward should fund 35 open issues costing ₹9.0 lakh, starting with manhole covers on Juhu Tara Road, Andheri Subway and SV Road. The remaining ₹10.5 lakh covers all of them.
